reason: Both are building-envelope manufacturers selling roofing and insulation products through distributors and contractors, so there is real overlap. Carlisle is centered on commercial single-ply roofing, polyiso insulation and weatherproofing (CCM and CWT). Owens Corning's cited evidence points to a broader and more residential mix: shingles, insulation, doors and glass-fiber nonwovens and composites. Only the polyiso facer line (C:P2.7) is directly tied to commercial roofing, and it is a component sold into that market. Product and customer overlap are both partial, so this is adjacent, not a direct competitor.
